questions.question: The quality of these products ___ outstanding.
questions.explanation: The subject of the sentence is 'quality', which is singular, not 'products'.

description.en: The subject of the sentence is 'quality', which is singular, not 'products'.
description.id: Subjek kalimatnya adalah 'quality', yang merupakan tunggal, bukan 'products'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The quality of these products are outstanding.
wrong_correct.correct: The quality of these products is outstanding.

explanation.en: Do not let the plural noun in the prepositional phrase ('products') distract you from the true singular subject ('quality').
explanation.id: Jangan biarkan kata benda jamak dalam frasa preposisional ('products') mengalihkan perhatian Anda dari subjek tunggal yang sebenarnya ('quality').

en.introduction: The subject of the sentence is 'quality', which is singular, not 'products'.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: When a singular subject is followed by a prepositional phrase containing a plural noun, the verb must agree with the singular subject.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.wrong: The quality of these products are outstanding.
common_mistakes.correct: The quality of these products is outstanding.
common_mistakes.reason: Do not let the plural noun in the prepositional phrase ('products') distract you from the true singular subject ('quality').

other_examples.sentence: Example: The quality of these products is outstanding.
other_examples.translation: Contoh: Kualitas produk-produk ini luar biasa.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of singular subject with prepositional phrase.
explanation.id: Ini mengikuti aturan subjek tunggal dengan frasa preposisional.

questions.question: Neither of the candidates ___ suitable for the position.
questions.explanation: 'Neither' is a singular indefinite pronoun and always takes a singular verb in formal English.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu sebagai Subjek Tunggal

description.en: 'Neither' is a singular indefinite pronoun and always takes a singular verb in formal English.
description.id: 'Neither' adalah kata ganti tak tentu tunggal dan selalu menggunakan kata kerja tunggal dalam bahasa Inggris formal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither of the candidates are suitable.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither of the candidates is suitable.

explanation.en: Although 'candidates' is plural, the subject is 'Neither', which is singular.
explanation.id: Meskipun 'candidates' jamak, subjeknya adalah 'Neither', yang merupakan tunggal.

en.introduction: 'Neither' is a singular indefinite pronoun and always takes a singular verb in formal English.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: Words like 'neither', 'either', 'each', and 'everyone' are grammatically singular and require singular verbs.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither of the candidates are suitable.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither of the candidates is suitable.
common_mistakes.reason: Although 'candidates' is plural, the subject is 'Neither', which is singular.

other_examples.sentence: Example: Neither of the candidates is suitable.
other_examples.translation: Contoh: Tidak satu pun dari kandidat tersebut cocok untuk posisi ini.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of indefinite pronouns as singular subjects.
explanation.id: Ini mengikuti aturan kata ganti tak tentu sebagai subjek tunggal.

questions.question: The news about the economy ___ encouraging.
questions.explanation: 'News' is an uncountable noun that ends in 's' but is grammatically singular.

subtopic.id: Kata Benda Tidak Dapat Dihitung yang Berakhiran 's'

description.en: 'News' is an uncountable noun that ends in 's' but is grammatically singular.
description.id: 'News' adalah kata benda yang tidak dapat dihitung yang berakhiran 's' tetapi secara tata bahasa adalah tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: The news about the economy are encouraging.
wrong_correct.correct: The news about the economy is encouraging.

explanation.en: Do not assume a word is plural just because it ends in 's'. 'News' is always singular.
explanation.id: Jangan berasumsi kata itu jamak hanya karena berakhiran 's'. 'News' selalu tunggal.

en.introduction: 'News' is an uncountable noun that ends in 's' but is grammatically singular.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: Certain nouns ending in 's' (e.g., news, mathematics, physics, measles) are singular and take singular verbs.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.wrong: The news about the economy are encouraging.
common_mistakes.correct: The news about the economy is encouraging.
common_mistakes.reason: Do not assume a word is plural just because it ends in 's'. 'News' is always singular.

other_examples.sentence: Example: The news about the economy is encouraging.
other_examples.translation: Contoh: Berita tentang ekonomi itu menggembirakan.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of uncountable nouns ending in 's'.
explanation.id: Ini mengikuti aturan kata benda tidak dapat dihitung yang berakhiran 's'.

questions.question: Physics ___ a challenging subject for many students.
questions.explanation: Names of academic subjects ending in 's' are treated as singular nouns.

description.en: Names of academic subjects ending in 's' are treated as singular nouns.
description.id: Nama mata pelajaran akademik yang berakhiran 's' diperlakukan sebagai kata benda tunggal.

explanation.en: The field of study is a single entity, so it requires a singular verb.
explanation.id: Bidang studi adalah satu entitas, sehingga memerlukan kata kerja tunggal.

en.introduction: Names of academic subjects ending in 's' are treated as singular nouns.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: Academic subjects like physics, mathematics, economics, and linguistics take singular verbs.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.reason: The field of study is a single entity, so it requires a singular verb.

other_examples.sentence: Example: Physics is a challenging subject.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of names of subjects ending in 's'.
explanation.id: Ini mengikuti aturan nama mata pelajaran yang berakhiran 's'.

questions.question: The police ___ investigating the incident thoroughly.
questions.explanation: 'Police' is a plural noun and always takes a plural verb.

description.en: 'Police' is a plural noun and always takes a plural verb.
description.id: 'Police' adalah kata benda jamak dan selalu menggunakan kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: The police is investigating the incident.
wrong_correct.correct: The police are investigating the incident.

explanation.en: 'Police' refers to multiple officers, so it must be paired with a plural verb.
explanation.id: 'Police' merujuk pada beberapa petugas, sehingga harus dipasangkan dengan kata kerja jamak.

en.introduction: 'Police' is a plural noun and always takes a plural verb.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: Certain collective nouns like 'police', 'people', and 'cattle' are grammatically plural and require plural verbs.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.wrong: The police is investigating the incident.
common_mistakes.correct: The police are investigating the incident.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Police' refers to multiple officers, so it must be paired with a plural verb.

other_examples.sentence: Example: The police are investigating the incident.
other_examples.translation: Contoh: Polisi sedang menyelidiki insiden tersebut secara menyeluruh.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of plural-only nouns.
explanation.id: Ini mengikuti aturan kata benda yang hanya jamak.

questions.question: Ten dollars ___ a reasonable price for this book.
questions.explanation: Amounts of money, when considered as a single unit, take a singular verb.

description.en: Amounts of money, when considered as a single unit, take a singular verb.
description.id: Jumlah uang, ketika dianggap sebagai satu unit, menggunakan kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Ten dollars are a reasonable price.
wrong_correct.correct: Ten dollars is a reasonable price.

explanation.en: The amount 'ten dollars' is viewed as a single sum, not ten individual dollar bills.
explanation.id: Jumlah 'ten dollars' dipandang sebagai satu jumlah total, bukan sepuluh lembar uang satu dolar.

en.introduction: Amounts of money, when considered as a single unit, take a singular verb.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: Expressions of time, money, distance, and weight are treated as singular when they represent a total amount.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.wrong: Ten dollars are a reasonable price.
common_mistakes.correct: Ten dollars is a reasonable price.
common_mistakes.reason: The amount 'ten dollars' is viewed as a single sum, not ten individual dollar bills.

other_examples.sentence: Example: Ten dollars is a reasonable price.
other_examples.translation: Contoh: Sepuluh dolar adalah harga yang wajar untuk buku ini.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of amounts and measurements.
explanation.id: Ini mengikuti aturan jumlah dan pengukuran.

questions.question: The scissors ___ on the table.
questions.explanation: 'Scissors' is a plural noun (pluralia tantum) and requires a plural verb.

subtopic.id: Pluralia Tantum (Kata Benda yang Hanya Jamak)

description.en: 'Scissors' is a plural noun (pluralia tantum) and requires a plural verb.
description.id: 'Scissors' adalah kata benda jamak (pluralia tantum) dan memerlukan kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: The scissors is on the table.
wrong_correct.correct: The scissors are on the table.

explanation.en: Do not treat tools with two symmetrical parts as singular. Use 'a pair of scissors is' if you need a singular subject.
explanation.id: Jangan perlakukan alat dengan dua bagian simetris sebagai tunggal. Gunakan 'a pair of scissors is' jika Anda memerlukan subjek tunggal.

en.introduction: 'Scissors' is a plural noun (pluralia tantum) and requires a plural verb.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: Nouns that consist of two parts, such as scissors, glasses, pants, and tweezers, are plural.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.wrong: The scissors is on the table.
common_mistakes.correct: The scissors are on the table.
common_mistakes.reason: Do not treat tools with two symmetrical parts as singular. Use 'a pair of scissors is' if you need a singular subject.

other_examples.sentence: Example: The scissors are on the table.
other_examples.translation: Contoh: Gunting itu ada di atas meja.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of pluralia tantum (plural-only nouns).
explanation.id: Ini mengikuti aturan pluralia tantum (kata benda yang hanya jamak).

questions.explanation: Names of diseases ending in 's', like measles or mumps, are singular.

description.en: Names of diseases ending in 's', like measles or mumps, are singular.
description.id: Nama penyakit yang berakhiran 's', seperti measles atau mumps, adalah tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Measles are a highly contagious disease.
wrong_correct.correct: Measles is a highly contagious disease.

explanation.en: Despite the 's' ending, 'measles' refers to a single disease entity.
explanation.id: Meskipun berakhiran 's', 'measles' merujuk pada satu entitas penyakit.

en.introduction: Names of diseases ending in 's', like measles or mumps, are singular.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: Disease names ending in 's' are treated as singular nouns and take singular verbs.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.wrong: Measles are a highly contagious disease.
common_mistakes.correct: Measles is a highly contagious disease.

other_examples.sentence: Example: Measles is a highly contagious disease.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of diseases ending in 's'.
explanation.id: Ini mengikuti aturan penyakit yang berakhiran 's'.

questions.question: The data ___ inconclusive at this stage of the research.
questions.explanation: In formal and academic English, 'data' is the plural of 'datum' and takes a plural verb.

description.en: In formal and academic English, 'data' is the plural of 'datum' and takes a plural verb.
description.id: Dalam bahasa Inggris formal dan akademik, 'data' adalah bentuk jamak dari 'datum' dan menggunakan kata kerja jamak.

explanation.en: In academic testing, 'data' is strictly plural. Use 'are' to match the plural subject.
explanation.id: Dalam pengujian akademik, 'data' secara ketat adalah jamak. Gunakan 'are' untuk mencocokkan subjek jamak.

en.introduction: In formal and academic English, 'data' is the plural of 'datum' and takes a plural verb.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: While 'data' is sometimes used as a singular mass noun in informal contexts, formal writing requires it to be treated as plural.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.reason: In academic testing, 'data' is strictly plural. Use 'are' to match the plural subject.

explanation.en: This follows the rule of latin plurals (data).

description.en: The subject is 'Everyone', which is a singular indefinite pronoun, regardless of the plural noun in the prepositional phrase.
description.id: Subjeknya adalah 'Everyone', yang merupakan kata ganti tak tentu tunggal, terlepas dari kata benda jamak dalam frasa preposisional.

wrong_correct.wrong: Everyone in the rooms are ready to leave.
wrong_correct.correct: Everyone in the rooms is ready to leave.

explanation.en: Do not be distracted by the plural object of the preposition ('rooms'). The subject 'Everyone' dictates the singular verb.
explanation.id: Jangan teralihkan oleh objek preposisi jamak ('rooms'). Subjek 'Everyone' yang menentukan kata kerja tunggal.

en.introduction: The subject is 'Everyone', which is a singular indefinite pronoun, regardless of the plural noun in the prepositional phrase.

rules.title: Core Rule
rules.explanation: Indefinite pronouns like everyone, everybody, someone, and nobody are always singular.
notes: Pay close attention to the true subject, not the nouns in interrupting phrases or prepositional phrases.

common_mistakes.wrong: Everyone in the rooms are ready to leave.
